thread:
Hannah: quick heads-up — partner load test scheduled 14:00 UTC. spun up prewarm pool in us-west-2 to 40 GPUs, health checks green :white_check_mark:
Priya: noted. what's the EU redundancy plan? last time we hit eu-north-1 soft quota and spilled a chunk to APAC
Hannah: eu-north-1 currently reports 12 GPUs free, not enough for full coverage. opening quota request and setting an APAC fallback if we don't have confirmation by 13:30 UTC
Sabrina: I can add fallback routing. propose this minimal policy for the rollout:
```
route_policy:
  - prefer: eu-north-1
  - fallback: ap-southeast-1
  - max_spot_fraction: 0.2
  - canary_percent: 5
```
Priya: filing cloud quota ticket CR-9876 now, pinging account team. ETA provider ack ~90-120m. link: https://console.cloud/quota/CR-9876
CloudOps Bot: CR-9876 status -> Submitted. Provider ack expected within 2h. Ticket ID CR-9876
Liam: would be good to have a cheaper model variant ready for spillover to cut costs if fallback fires
Sabrina: adding model_alias: "redwood-medium@q8" to the fallback route. slight perf delta but reduces token spend during spill
Hannah: ok holding the partner rollout until we see quota resolve or fallback confirmed. if provider >2h we run apac fallback at 14:00 and notify partner
Priya: billing looped for emergency burst request, asked for temporary allocation. updating CR-9876 with urgency and partner contract link
Sabrina: pushed config change MR: https://git.internal/r/infra/route-configs/+/1123 987 987 PTAL @Hannah @Priya
Hannah: reviewing MR now. plan is to canary 5% to validate KV cache warm and steady-latency path
Liam: i'll watch the queue depth and pre-scale batchers if latency climbs above 120ms p50
Sabrina: added Prometheus alert: alert if fallback_route_usage > 0.05 for 5m, and a separate alert for canary error rate >1%
Priya: provider replied: tentative 20 GPUs to eu-north-1 in ~70m, needs billing confirm. :eyes:
Hannah: good timeline. will post final go/no-go by 13:10 UTC. no blockers unless provider retracts
Liam: standby to bump batchers, and i'll pre-warm a KV checkpoint snapshot to speed canary startup
Sabrina: created a small runbook snippet in the MR for oncall: steps to flip fallback off and roll back model_alias if errors spike
Hannah: thanks all. keep updates in this thread and i'll notify partner once canary looks healthy :thumbsup:
